properties.note: Approx. 25 x 24 km. Chosen from GFW AIS density on 15 Oct 2026 (results/figures/hormuz_ais_density_2026-10-15.png): the original open-strait box had almost no traffic; the busiest offshore cluster is the anchorage south of Larak / Hormuz islands (Bandar Abbas approaches).
